The '''Heavy-Duty Power Unit''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] torso manufactured by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. It was made of [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]]-[[molybdenum]], [[Steel/Legends|steel]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]] and [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]], all of which had a high durability. Due to the materials it was made of, it only weighed 60.5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and was magnetic. That small, lightweight torso also contained a generator and had a good [[Battery/Legends|battery]] capacity.<ref name="DW" />
